name: seblful-claude-plugins
description: Curated Claude Code plugins grouped by what they act on — Python code, any codebase, your notes, and the conversation itself.

plugins.name: python
plugins.description: Robust Python coding and testing practices — intent-obvious code, illegal states unrepresentable, type-driven safety net, on top of the uv/ruff/ty/pytest stack.

plugins.name: code
plugins.description: Tools that act on a codebase — a senior code-reviewer agent, a feedback-loop-first diagnosing-bugs skill, the codebase-design vocabulary, and an architecture-review command that surfaces deepening opportunities as a visual HTML report.

plugins.name: obsidian-vault
plugins.description: Maintenance and authoring routines for Obsidian vaults — formatting, knowledge harvesting into projects, weekly reports by project, structural scanning, accuracy review, wikilink connectivity, file cleanup, inbox ingestion, building maps of content, and authoring or rewriting source-of-truth reference notes.

plugins.name: lenses
plugins.description: Tools that act on you and the conversation rather than the code — a high-level code map (zoom-out), ultra-compressed caveman mode, one-question-at-a-time plan grilling, and a stateful multi-session teaching workspace.

plugins.name: issues
plugins.description: Turn a session's failures and follow-ups into GitHub issues in the seblful-claude-plugins backlog repo — drafted from the conversation, dedup-checked, labeled from existing labels, and confirmed before anything is filed, no matter which project you're working in.
